svg.title: Molecule of the day: Propranolol
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Propranolol while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 0.91.
svg.text: MW 259.3 · cLogP 2.58 · TPSA 41.5 · HBD 2 · HBA 3 · RotB 6
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
